text: Visitors have noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly the lack of clear directions to handicap parking and limited shuttle service from the parking lot to the entrance. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed or detracting from the experience. Some visitors were frustrated by timed entry policies and wait times, including the need to purchase tickets in advance and delays in gaining entry. Food options in the café received some negative comments for limited choices. Overall, while the building and exhibits were generally well received, these operational and interpretive concerns stood out in recent feedback.
